title.zh: 【纳斯达克被指劝阻上市公司通过 OKXICE 进行股票代币化，官方拒绝置评】
title.en: 【纳斯达克被指劝阻上市公司通过 OKXICE 进行股票代币化，官方拒绝置评】

current_state.zh: Nasdaq declined to comment on allegations it discouraged listed companies from tokenizing their shares via OKXICE's TSV scheme, reiterating it will not participate in platforms operating under the SEC innovation exemption and will instead pursue its own issuer-centric Nasdaq Equity Token model.
current_state.en: Nasdaq declined to comment on allegations it discouraged listed companies from tokenizing their shares via OKXICE's TSV scheme, reiterating it will not participate in platforms operating under the SEC innovation exemption and will instead pursue its own issuer-centric Nasdaq Equity Token model.
